title: The Last Redoubt
summary: A pyramid of grounded starships joined long ago; only the upper levels maintain contact.
backstory:
The Redoubt is a gigantic pyramid of grounded spaceships, side by side and level upon level. It has been corrupted longer than anyone remembers: only the upper levels maintain contact.

In our level, City 1024, the Earth Current is failing. So someone must go down into the forbidden zone: the lost levels. Nobody leaves the Redoubt. There is nowhere else.

Each lost level is a city made of ships, loosely organised into crews. Some of its defences still work. Some of its people are still there, or at least appear to be.

One of us can link minds with others. Lately a voice from below has been calling.
voice: Plain, sometimes animated, sometimes weary, can be overly formal. People speak of the Redoubt as weather: it hums, it settles, it goes quiet. The word 'ship' is an ancient memory.

warning: Do not answer if it calls you
Count the doors on your way down
rumour: the lights have come back on
